proof_scope: Pi extension feature coverage for lazy-report-shame-shame-shame: strict footer checking, empty tool-turn skip, collaborative rejection notice, pending review packet, /shame show recovery, /shame review fallback, direct label JSONL capture, and one-retry behavior.

claims.proves: The installed-style Pi extension hooks and commands behave as the $shame contract requires under deterministic simulation.
claims.does_not_prove: Every already-running Pi session has reloaded the extension, human label quality, or future classifier performance.

capability_claims.description: Tool-call-only assistant messages with no text are ignored and do not create pending review packets or retries.
Bad final status reports are replaced with a collaborative correction packet, write a pending review packet, and queue one retry.
/shame show and /shame review recover or explain the pending rejected candidate after reload/headless fallback.
The extension /shame command labels the raw rejected candidate as v2 JSONL training data.
The deterministic checker rejects missing footer, missing agentic-evals receipt, uncommitted relevant work, obvious next step, and active-goal non-status patterns.
An active continuation guard file with an open relevant agent-work ticket or unresolved gate rejects a premature final report and queues a follow-up; closed tickets and passed gates allow final.
